Dangerous Goods

フォームインサート

A precut or custom-formed foam component placed inside packaging to immobilize and protect dangerous goods, widely used for laboratory vials or sensitive instruments.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is フォームインサート?

In this glossary, フォームインサート refers to: A precut or custom-formed foam component placed inside packaging to immobilize and protect dangerous goods, widely used for laboratory vials or sensitive instruments.

How is フォームインサート used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "危険物に分類される高価で壊れやすい実験サンプルの梱包にはフォームインサートが必須です。"

Why does フォームインサート matter in logistics?

フォームインサート matters because it supports clear communication in Dangerous Goods contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses フォームインサート?

フォームインサート is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does フォームインサート belong to?

In this glossary, フォームインサート is grouped under Dangerous Goods. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A precut or custom-formed foam component placed inside packaging to immobilize and protect dangerous goods, widely used for laboratory vials or sensitive instruments.

Operational example

Foam inserts are mandatory in packaging used for high-value, fragile laboratory samples classified as dangerous goods.

Localized term

フォームインサート

Localized example
